# MD Shahed

> Md Shahed — Bangladesh-based entrepreneur, businessman, and web developer specializing in React.js, Next.js, SEO, branding, and scalable web applications focused on business growth and modern digital experiences.

Md Shahed combines technology, branding, and business strategy to build impactful, performance-driven digital solutions for startups, SMEs, and enterprises — locally in Dhaka, Bangladesh and globally.
